page.title: Sponsors
page.description: Sponsor the McMaster Rocketry Team: tiers, what your support buys, and who to contact.
headline: Put your name
on a rocket.
page.lede: We're a student team that designs, builds and flies its own vehicles. Sponsorship pays for materials, motors and getting our roughly 20-person competition crew to a launch site. It also puts your company in front of them while they decide where to work.

budget.headline: Where the money goes.
budget.lede: We publish this because sponsors ask. A team that won't say where the money goes isn't a team worth funding.

tiers.headline: What you get.
tiers.lede: Three tiers, and a fourth option if you'd rather give materials or machine time than money. That is often more useful to us.

partners.headline: Who backs us.
partners.lede: Logo placement follows tier: larger on paper for Gold, medium for Silver, compact for Bronze. Each links to the partner's site.

contact.headline: Who to ask.
contact.lede: Email someone, and hear back from someone.

packageCard.headline: Get package
packageCard.body: The 2026-27 sponsorship package: tiers, benefits, and what we fly.

inKind: We'll take materials, machine shop CNC time, PCBs, connectors, or test equipment in place of cash. Tell us what you have and we'll say whether we can use it.

budget.label: Airframe
budget.note: commercial motor fuel and casing assembly, stock metal and fasteners for structural components

budget.label: Payload
budget.note: technical experiment, control PCBs, metal stock and fasteners, workspace equipment

budget.label: Recovery
budget.note: parachutes, recovery harness lines and hardware, commercial recovery electronics, airbrake structure

budget.label: Controls and avionics bay
budget.note: recovery control PCBs, flight data acquisition, avionics bay structure

budget.label: Composite manufacturing
budget.note: fibreglass and carbon fibre, epoxy, jigs, PPE

budget.label: Operations
budget.note: campus outreach, recruitment, and team logistics

budget.label: Propulsion
budget.note: engine assembly, pressure testing setup, fill system, engine testing, fuel casting setup

tiers.name: Bronze
benefits: Small logo placement on the website and T-shirts
Logo in all team videos and presentations

tiers.name: Silver
benefits: Medium logo placement on the website, banner, T-shirts and rocket
Logo in all team videos and presentations
Short write-up on the sponsorship page

tiers.name: Gold
benefits: Large logo placement on the website, banner, T-shirt and rocket
Logo in all team videos and presentations
Long write-up on the sponsorship page
Custom promotion when you ask for it
